title: Chapter 760 The Fall Of The Holy Master; The Heavens And Earth Mourn Together!
content:
Chapter 760 The Fall Of The Holy Master; The Heavens And Earth Mourn Together!

Chapter 760  The Fall of the Holy Master; the Heavens and Earth Mourn Together!

At this moment.

Almost all the living beings raised their heads to look at the tall figure. Their eyes were filled with yearning, excitement, and speculation...

As the owner of this figure, Lin Fan was currently floating in the void above Earth.

He took a light breath, and the spiritual qi that permeated the void automatically gathered and entered his body like a river entering the sea.

Lin Fan clenched his fists gently. He felt as though he could control countless living beings with just a raise of his hand.

Mysterious and powerful to the extreme.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the system panel.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Early stage Holy Lord]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Sacred Lord-level), Curse Technique (Sacred King-level), Sword Nurturing Technique (Sacred Lord-level), Universe Sword Technique (Sacred Lord-level)...]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Holy Lord), Flame Armor (Holy Lord), Heavenly Soul Bead (Holy Lord), True Dragon Sword (Holy Lord)...]

[Laws: Time (Intermediate), Space (Advanced), Metal (Advanced), Wood (Advanced), Water (Advanced), Fire (Advanced), Earth (Advanced), Life (Advanced), Death (Advanced), Yin (Advanced), Yang (Advanced), Wind (Advanced)…]

[Character Relationship:

Lin Tao, Daddy, Favorability: 10 stars;

[Dai Weixue: Mom, favorability rating of 10 stars.]

Lin Xiaoyao, Sister, Favorability: 10 stars;

Xia Xue: Dao Companion, Favorability 10 stars;

[Xia Bing: Dao Companion, Favorability: 10 stars…]

He had finally reached the Holy Lord level.

Lin Fan's lips curled up. He was in a good mood.

If they were in a good mood, they should celebrate.

Hence, Lin Fan shifted his attention to Curse Arts and Tyrant.

[Do you want to spend 100 million spirit stones to curse Tai Ba?]

"Yes, sir!"

[Do you want to spend 100 million spirit stones to curse Tai Ba?]

"Yes, sir!"

[Do you want to spend 100 million spirit stones to curse Tai Ba?]

"Yes, sir!"

....

The curse only ended after ten times.

Lin Fan's face was filled with satisfaction.

....

On the other hand.

Demon Palace.

"Treasure…The treasure vault has been stolen!"

"The treasure vault has been stolen!"

"Someone come!"

"Someone come quickly!"

Shouts resounded throughout the entire Demon Palace.

The investigation and interrogation proceeded quickly.

However, there was no effect.

This made all the demons anxious.

One had to know that this treasure vault stored many of the most precious treasures of the demon race.

Among them, there were even things that even Sacred Lords cared about.

It was one of the demon race's foundations.

Now, they had all disappeared without a trace?

This was definitely a major event.

A major event that had never happened before in the demon race!

The current leader of the demon race admitted that he could not bear such a responsibility. After thinking about it again and again, he resolutely reported the matter to the demon ancestor…

Tyrannical!

Recently, Tai Ba had been suppressing the power of the curse with all his might. He had just stabilized a little when he received a report from the demon clan leader.

Originally, he didn't want to pay attention to it.

However, when he found out that his treasures had also been stolen.

He felt as if he had been slapped in the face and was a little angry.

Thus, Tai Ba still came to the Demon Palace from outside the 33 Heavens.

"Welcome, Demon Ancestor!" All the demons said in unison.

Their tone was filled with respect, excitement, and fear.

Tai Ba did not respond at all. He leaped and directly arrived at the treasure vault.

"When the inspectors arrived, the two king-level demons guarding the door had already fallen asleep," the demon lord hurriedly said."

Tai Ba's cold eyes swept over the two King level demons.

"What did you see?"

The two king-level demons said in a very mechanical voice,""We didn't see anything."

Tai Ba was using a special control technique that allowed him to know the true situation from the depths of his soul.

And they still gave the same answer. Clearly, they really didn't know.

Tai Ba frowned and took a step forward, entering the treasure vault.

The treasure vault was now empty. There was nothing left.

His eyes emitted golden light as he used a secret technique to investigate.

Instantly, time quickly reversed in his vision.

Back to when the treasure was still there.

While Tai Ba was silently watching, all the treasures suddenly evaporated.

Even he couldn't figure it out.

This was normal.

One had to know that Lin Fan's mastery of the Power of Time had already reached an extremely deep level.

Perhaps only Sacred Lords who specialized in time could see through it.

And Tai Ba only knew a little bit of it.

Naturally, he couldn't see Lin Fan.

On top of that, Lin Fan had even set up a Holy Master level formation on the surface. This had added to the disturbance.

Tai Ba's expression turned ugly.

He actually couldn't see it!

This explained many problems.

This was the attack of a Holy Lord!

Instantly, figures appeared in his mind.

He was about to say something.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, Tai Ba's body suddenly emitted a dense black aura of curse.

"Puff!"

He spat out a large mouthful of blood.

Then, a violent and brutal aura erupted like a volcano.

"Roar!"

Tai Ba let out a maniacal roar and shot out a circle of tyrannical energy, directly turning the treasure vault that was densely covered in protective power into dust.

The demon lord and the other demons were all attacked indiscriminately by Tai Ba. They spat out a mouthful of blood and looked very dispirited.

"Demon Ancestor, what happened?" The demon lord said in horror.

Tai Ba was not in the mood to answer.

He would laugh maniacally at times, cry at times, be angry at times, and be happy at times…His entire face became distorted.

At the same time, the power of the curse around him continued to rise.

"Roar!"

Tai Ba roared towards the sky once again, shooting out an incomparably powerful energy in all directions.

"Puff!"

With this roar, at least half of the Demon Palace had died.

The demon lord who was closer to him also fell to the ground and found it difficult to get up.

It was also this roar that gave Tai Ba an additional strand of consciousness.

He sensed his own condition, and his expression was extremely ugly.

This was because he realized that the curse had already covered his entire core. Moreover, it was continuously melting and destroying his core.

And he was simply unable to stop it!

Tai Ba became extremely crazy.

He swept up a terrifying energy and rushed into the void. He roared,"The Bodhi Fruit of the Buddhist Sect has mastered the Great Dao of Curse. It destroyed my Dao foundation and damaged my core. Today, I shall use all my life force and strength to curse the Bodhi Fruit!"

"Roar!"

Tai Ba roared again in the void.

"Boom!"

Then, his entire body exploded like the universe. Billions of dazzling lights shot out, illuminating countless worlds.

At the same time, a series of wails sounded between heaven and earth. Everyone felt an inexplicable sense of sadness.

The death of the Holy Master was a tragedy for the world!
